# RE-LY

RE-LY compared two fixed doses of dabigatran with adjusted-dose warfarin; the
[comparison page](../comparison/doac-vs-warfarin.md) sets it beside ARISTOTLE.

The trial was designed around one composite end point. The primary outcome was stroke or
systemic embolism
([Dabigatran versus warfarin in patients with atrial fibrillation](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_8a669b066c4cb002e5224ef48c9a8550.md "The primary outcome was stroke or systemic embolism.")).
